description: FirstTouch helps go-to-market teams run outbound workflows from ChatGPT. Users can build audiences from supplied contacts or a connected HubSpot list, author multi-step outreach flow plans made of email, call, manual, and branch actions, publish a flow once its configuration is valid, start selected awaiting contacts, and follow enrollment progress and the human tasks those flows create. Built-in workspace guidance keeps flow authoring aligned with the fields each tool actually accepts.

defaultPrompt: Build me an audience of 200 enterprise leads from my HubSpot list and get them ready for outreach.
Set up a 3-touch outreach sequence — email, a follow-up call, then a branch if they don't respond — and publish it.
Enroll my next batch of leads in the outreach flow and show me how the team's replies are trending.
